title: Söze: One Network Telemetry Is All You Need for Per-flow Weighted Bandwidth Allocation at Scale
problem: Achieving agile and precise weighted bandwidth allocation for large-scale cloud networks is fundamentally challenging.
motivation: Weighted bandwidth allocation is a powerful abstraction with many use cases in modern data center networks.
method: Söze is a lightweight decentralized system that leverages network telemetry features from commodity Ethernet switches. Given flow weights, it computes and enforces weighted bandwidth allocations using only telemetry information, without requiring per-flow, topology, or routing knowledge. The system uses decentralized computation to determine per-flow allocations based on switch-level metrics.
key_novelty: Using simple network telemetry from commodity switches to perform decentralized weighted bandwidth allocation without per-flow, topology, or routing knowledge.
contributions: Lightweight decentralized weighted bandwidth allocation system leveraging commodity switch telemetry
Method to compute per-flow allocations using only network telemetry without per-flow tracking or topology knowledge
Simulations and testbed validation demonstrating system effectiveness
Improvements of 0.59× (best case) and 0.79× (average) on TPC-H job completion time

metrics.speedup: 0.59× (best case), 0.79× (average) on TPC-H job completion time
